rationale: The 2021 five-project acquisition is real, but the original legal/project boundary and uninterrupted current UBS ownership were not proven. Later disclosures concern different 400 MW, approximately 700 MW and 730 MW portfolios, so creating a canonical active company would risk conflating distinct portfolios.
unresolvedQuestions: Which five original project/SPVs comprised the November 2021 acquisition?
Does the original five-project portfolio still exist as a single UBS-owned platform through 2026, or has it been reorganized, sold or merged into later portfolios?
sourceHealthCaveat: The model-selected primary UBS URL and the Power Technology URL are now dead; Business Wire required browser verification.
recommendedNextAction: Do not create or apply this PortCo. Resolve the five original SPVs and trace each to a current owner or a single surviving manager-level platform before reconsidering.
